somos.title: Who are we?
somos.description: A family-owned company dedicated to the production and export of vegetables, mainly cilantro, green onions, zucchini, and broccoli, of the highest quality, cultivated with passion and care in our fields. Our commitment to excellence, sustainability, and innovation has positioned us as a benchmark in the international market, reaching every corner. We guarantee an impeccable process, ensuring that each vegetable retains its freshness, color, and aroma, offering our customers a premium product that exceeds expectations. At Sons Farms, we flourish with every shipment.
